name: Junior Volunteer Program (Student Ambassador Program), Pennsylvania Hospital
what_you_do: Help at a big Philadelphia hospital in the summer and see the jobs people do there. It is meant for teens who like health care, but anyone can apply.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 17. The program targets high school students interested in health care, but all students are invited to apply.
deadline_text: The 2026 program closed early because of high demand. Applications for Summer 2027 open February 1, 2027. No closing date is posted, so apply early.
how_to_apply: Starting February 1, 2027, create an account in the Penn Medicine volunteer portal and apply. More details will be posted closer to that date.
notes: It is only at the 800 Spruce Street site. Spots fill fast. Email PAHVolunteerServices@pennmedicine.upenn.edu or call 215-829-5187.
